reason: It costs me nothing, and getting several written prices side by side is the only way I'll find a small starter system I can afford and add to later. I'd send one request just to see the numbers, but I'm not promising to buy anything.
objection: Once my number is out, I expect companies to ring me every day pushing a bigger system than I can pay for. 'Only the companies you choose' sounds good, but I'll believe it when my phone stays quiet.
would_change_my_mind: If I started getting calls from companies I never picked, I'd delete the app and stop using it.
